book.name: Matyu
book.title: Matyu Yesu guun kan ka minin ganin bilungwa

content: Yesu gain kwi kulungwa
Ena are kaun anan kole muru kole taran wei sungure, Pita te kebin abin sui Yemis te Yon, Yesu yal kobi awli i kamin kuul bil maangwa ongwa. Pi inin mile paangwa.
Yesu igin gain kwi kulungure yal sutakobe kanungwa. Yalini are dongwa mere guman iru kulungwa, te gal pirungwa naabile aw dungwa.
Mose te Ilaya bole Yesu ka diria ere milungwa yal sutakobe para kanungwa.
Kanemia ena Pita iru di Yesu tongwa, “Singabo, na yal kobe abila milebinga wai pirebinwa. ‘Are dine ogu bil sutakobe kiyo,’ dinanga kiirabinwa. Ta i ki tere, ta Mose ki tere, ta Ilaya ki terabinwa.”
Ka i di milungure kawa ta naabilungwa yobile suna erungure kawa ye suna erungwa ali ka ta iru dungwa, “Yalini na Wanan taran milemia nomanin wai tere, gun ye teiwa. Yalini ka dungwa piro.”
Dungwa i, gawlima sutakobe pirere kalgane ire kuril pire ole si main pire yaa i kwi bilungwa.
I kwi bilimba Yesu ure gain mina aa tere iru di tongwa, “Ena i kuril pirekio, alo.”
Dimia ena yal sutakobe kane yebe ere ibal kobe ta milekungure, Yesu inin milungwa kanemia.

Kamin kuul wi ime ongwa Yesu yal sutakobe kiraan aa tere iru di tongwa, “I kal guman kwi dungwa kaninga, ibal kobe malia di maribe ere tekio. Na U Ibal Obinga Yal gulere kwi alalga kaun, ka iru di maribe ere ibal tenanwa.”
Dungure gawlima sutakobe sirin bile Yesu tongwa, “‘Ilaya goma u maribe namua,’ dire Yuda ka main nil si tongwa yalin kobe tameran iru dime?”
Sirin bile tongure Yesu waa dire iru dungwa, “Ilaya kawo goma urere kalkan para muru aa tekun eramua.

Iru dimba na iru di teralwa. Ilaya kaya umiiba, ibal kobe yalini guman ta kanekire, inin nomanin si pirungwa mere iru ere yalini tomua. Ere yalini tongwa mere, yalin kobe para Na U Ibal Obinga Yal giil pire na tenamua.”
Dimia ena gawlima sutakobe iru nomanin si pirungwa, “Ayo, malia nil bile tongwa yal Yon milungwa mere pire dimua,” dungwa.
Gaan ta sia den miriin suna milungwa, Yesu maa si mena erungwa
Ena yalin kobe pi ibal binanbile milungwa gul ongure, yal ta Yesu milungwa gul yaa gobin bile mile
iru di tongwa, “Singabo, i miriin wen pire na wanan to. Yalini kamina egilungwa yal milemia nuure omilin maalangwa, ena gaul si enderin te nil ali ere milemua.
I gawlimanin kobe aa te wai ere tenama dire awli ubinba, aa te wai erala di erimba, kuunin paikimua.”

Dungure Yesu maan dire iru di yalini tongwa, “Ayo, i yal kobe malia maalinga pire gi dikire, taalime eringa ibal milinwa. Kaun tamintan inin bole imo mile pairale? Kaun tamintan i taalime eringa na obin ere kine ire warabine? Gaan iray awli na na to.”
Dire, sia kan tongure sia u mena ongure dungwa kaun wen i, gaan gin taran pilaan pai milemia.
Ena gawlima kobe pi Yesu milungwa gul pire, yalin kobe inin ku bile milere iru sirin bile tongwa, “Tameran na yal kobe sia maa si mena erabina di erebinga paikime?”

Dungure Yesu maan iru di tongwa, “I pire gi tawliga dingiray paikimua. Na kawen di terala i piro. Koruul milin dungwa mere iru pire gi dinanga, ena ‘Kamin kuul ta i pi baan ta po,’ dinanga namua. Kal para wen erala di piranga ena eranga painamua.
[I komina mawal ere ana di God tere, ‘Aa ki di na to,’ dinanga ena sia iru maa si mena eranba, ana iru di tekenanga kuunin ta erekinanwa,” dungwa.]
Yesu gulere alalwa kwi ama dungwa
Ena gawlima kobe para Galili gariba gul u ku bilungure, Yesu iru di tongwa, “Na U Ibal Obinga Yal, yal kobe na kanin sire awli ibal tenamua.
Tenangure na si gulamba, are kaun sutakobe wei sinangure kwi alalwa.” Dungure gawlima kobe miriin pirungwa.
Yudia ka main ogu kobile takis tongwa Yesu ka dungwa
Ena yalin kobe Kapanaum ai u bawa dungure ka main ogu kobile takis ingwa yal kobe, Pita milungwa gul ure iru sirin bile tongwa, “I nil si tongwa yal, ka main ogu kobile takis tom mo, tekeme?”

Dungure Pita, “Tomua,” dungwa. Dire ogu ala pire ka dirala dimba, Yesu kaya dire iru di Pita tongwa, “Gariba gul yal bil kobe kobile takis ingwa we. Enin taw kobe tom mo, gariba baan ta ibal tome? I inin nomanin si piranga mere di na to.”
Sirin bilungure Pita, “Baan ta ibal tomua,” dungure ena Yesu iru di tongwa, “I iru dingi, ena enin kobe tekenangwa paikinamua.

Paikinamba, nigi de pire na yasu ta tekinangwa, ena i nil benge pire nil kabe sungwa kan pusi nil ali ere, nil kabe goma sinangure giran ali aa paule kananga, kobile moni dinamua. Ka main ogu kobile takis pi kobile i tenanga, na te i takis terabinga mere kuunin painamua,” dungwa.
